_notes: The researched figures for this model (docs/15_vehicle_preparation_pipeline.md#D15-S11).
syndicate-prepare derives everything else about a vehicle from its geometry, which is what
makes 'drop in a model' true. It cannot derive which car this IS: the published kerb mass,
the crank power and the drag area are research, and the difference between this car and the
Stampede is the entire content of the choice a player makes between them (DEC-033).
Every number here is a copy. dev.syndicate.core.vehicle.VehicleProfiles.ECLIPSE is the
authority, it carries the derivations and the sources, and VehicleProfileContentTest asserts
the shipped content against it field by field — so a figure that drifts fails the build with
the name of the figure and both values.
Stats are in the part.json shape: an object with add and/or mul. A mul is relative to the
runtime default, which is why the steering figures are ratios rather than radians.
